main.description: A picture a check made, from its runner's PDS: only one the check names, of a repository by a runner it names. Served so that a browser never runs it as a page, and the same for good. No authentication; responses are not personalized.

errors.description: No such repository, check, or picture of the check.
errors.name: NotFound

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record. Its authority may be a handle; a name the repository had before, or an owner it moved from with its agreement, finds it under the name it has now.

uri.description: The dev.knotless.check record, by a runner the repository names.
